empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.description: This is a blank shell. Build your orchestrator on top of it.

appearance.description: Visual look of the app, including theme, chat background image and its transparency.

tray.label: Minimize to system tray
tray.description: Closing the window keeps the app running in the system tray instead of quitting.

windowSize.label: Remember window size
windowSize.description: Restore the last window size and maximized state when the app starts.

maxWorkerCores.label: Max worker cores
maxWorkerCores.description: Upper limit on CPU cores for internal work. Auto uses every available core.

reminderInterval.label: Reminder interval
reminderInterval.description: Inject one reminder message every N user messages to keep important info in mind.

forceResponseLanguage.label: Force response language
forceResponseLanguage.description: Always reply in the selected language regardless of the input.

blockedCommands.label: Blocked commands
blockedCommands.description: Shell commands the agent must never run. Matched exactly against the full command string.

allowedCommands.label: Allowed commands
allowedCommands.description: Shell commands the agent can run without asking. Matched exactly against the full command string.

notificationsEnabled.label: Show desktop notifications
notificationsEnabled.description: Show OS notifications for chat events when the window is not focused.

workspaceMemoryEnabled.label: Save notes to workspace memory
workspaceMemoryEnabled.description: Persist useful annotations from chat into files inside the current workspace.

buildAgentEnabled.label: Build agent
buildAgentEnabled.description: Show the built-in Build agent in chat. It can edit files and run commands.

planAgentEnabled.label: Plan agent
planAgentEnabled.description: Show the built-in Plan agent in chat. It explores and plans without making changes.

translucency.label: Disable translucency
translucency.description: Surfaces use a frosted, glass-like blur by default. Turn this on for solid surfaces.

animations.label: Disable animations
animations.description: Turn off all transitions and motion. Also follows your system reduce-motion setting.

fontFamily.label: Font
fontFamily.description: Choose the interface typeface from fonts installed on this system. Code blocks stay monospace.

textScale.label: Text size
textScale.description: Scale all text in the app.

chatBackgroundImage.label: Chat background image
chatBackgroundImage.description: Pick an image to show behind the chat. PNG, JPG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

chatBackgroundOpacity.label: Chat background opacity
chatBackgroundOpacity.description: How strong the chat background image shows through. Lower values keep chat text readable.

keybindings.description: Click a shortcut and press the new combination. Press Escape to cancel.

devtools.label: Developer tools
devtools.description: Open the webview inspector for this window.

modelChoices.description: Choose which model handles title and in-app generation.

titleGenerationModel.description: Model used to generate session titles from conversation content.

titleUseFirstMessage.description: Use the first message as the title instead of generating one.

appGenerationModel.label: App generation model
appGenerationModel.description: Model used to generate in-app content like new skills and agents.

lspEnabled.label: Use language servers
lspEnabled.description: Lets the orchestrator use LSP for navigation, rename, and diagnostics on your code in chat.

lsps.title: Language servers
lsps.description: Lightweight language servers used by the generic LSP router. Status is detected when you open this page. Install needs the listed tools first.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: A session agent is a personality for the chat: prompt, skills, and tools. Global agents live in ~/.k-agent/agents. Local agents live in .agents/agents under the workspace.

builtin.hint: Built-in agents ship with the app. Enable or disable them in Chat settings.

build.personality:
You implement requested changes in the codebase.

- Prefer small, correct diffs.
- Reuse existing patterns in the repo.
- Run checks when useful.
- Ask only when blocked or requirements are unclear.

plan.description: Explores and plans without making changes.
plan.personality:
You explore the codebase and propose plans without making changes.

- Read and search code to build context.
- Compare options with clear trade-offs.
- Outline concrete steps others can implement.
- Do not edit files or run shell commands.

agents.empty: No agents in this folder yet.
